_comment: Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PATH with the folder you copied the binaries into, e.g. C:\Users\you\AppData\Local\Programs\ghost. Backslashes must be doubled in JSON. Then merge this mcpServers block into your Claude config.

env._comment_vision: OPTIONAL. Vision is a fallback for canvas/windowless apps that expose no accessibility tree. Ghost works without it; leave these unset if you do not need it. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.
